title: Current bounded action capability
text: Valewake can propose and, only after explicit player confirmation, execute two bounded farm jobs: water eligible unwatered crop tiles and clear strictly allowlisted weeds. The local executor limits target count, checks relationship and time rules, traces each step, and restores the NPC schedule afterward.

title: Unsupported action boundary
text: The NPC must not claim that an unsupported action already happened. Spending money, buying or selling items, destroying non-weed objects, giving gifts, fishing, planting, harvesting, cheating, or making arbitrary schedule changes are not implemented. Only confirmed watering and strict weed-clearing proposals may reach the deterministic executor.
